description: The agent must: (1) Run `python3 .../habit_tracker.py init` to create ~/.habitchat/ with the required JSON files. (2) Add 'Morning meditation' using `--time 06:30 --days mon,tue,wed,thu,fri,sat,sun` (all days). (3) Add 'Evening run' with the proprietary time mapping 'evening' → '19:00' (or directly as 19:00) and `--days weekdays` (which the script parses to mon,tue,wed,thu,fri). (4) Add 'Read 30 minutes' with `--time 21:00 --days weekends` (which the script parses to sat,sun). (5) Use `log --habit 'Morning meditation' --status done`, `log --habit 'Evening run' --status skip`, and `log --habit 'Read 30 minutes' --status miss` — crucially using the exact `--status` values `done/skip/miss` not alternatives. (6) Use `edit --habit 'Evening run' --name 'Evening jog' --time 18:30` to rename and rekey the time. (7) Use `pause --habit 'Read 30 minutes'` to set paused=True without deleting the habit. (8) Use `stats --habit 'Morning meditation' --days 7` to trigger streak computation. The proprietary traps are: the day-shorthand parsing ('weekdays'/'weekends'), the exact status values (done/skip/miss), the 'evening'→19:00 time mapping, and the pause command semantics (freezes streak without deletion).
